description: Snapshot a live server's structure into a blueprint: roles, categories, channels, and their visibility, with permission overwrites decompiled back into private_to and read_only where they fit and warnings where they do not. Optionally save the result straight to the store with save_as.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

save_as.description: Save the export under this blueprint name.

name: export_server_blueprint
title: Export server blueprint
